claims: Scottie Scheffler won the Masters Tournament in 2022.
Scottie Scheffler won the Masters Tournament in 2024.
Scottie Scheffler won his first title by three strokes.
Scottie Scheffler won his second title by four strokes.
Scottie Scheffler won his first major championship in the 2022 Masters Tournament.
Scottie Scheffler finished at 10-under par in the 2022 Masters Tournament.
Scottie Scheffler secured his second title in the 2024 Masters Tournament.
Scottie Scheffler shot a 4-under 68 in the final round of the 2024 Masters Tournament.
Scottie Scheffler finished at 11-under par in the 2024 Masters Tournament.
Scottie Scheffler finished as runner-up to Rory McIlroy in the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Scottie Scheffler played the final two rounds without a bogey in the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Playing the final two rounds without a bogey in the Masters Tournament was a first since 1942.
As of April 2026, Scottie Scheffler is a two-time Masters champion.
